content: Ultralytics released YOLO11 (2024) and YOLO26 (2026) as successors to YOLOv8 (2023). YOLOv8 remains fully supported and stable in the ultralytics package; YOLO11/YOLO26 offer better speed/accuracy and are recommended for new projects, but the SPEC.md explicitly names YOLOv8 -- it is still a safe, well-documented, actively maintained choice via 'pip install ultralytics', with straightforward .export(format='onnx').
